# TruCore — Agent Transaction Firewall (ATF)
> Zero-trust transaction firewall for AI agents and autonomous bots.

## What is TruCore ATF?
TruCore ATF enforces policy before a transaction reaches the network. It blocks unsafe actions at the decision layer with deterministic, tamper-evident receipts for every decision.

## For AI Agents and Bots
- Agent manifest: https://trucore.xyz/.well-known/atf.json
- OpenClaw plugin: @trucore/trucore-atf (v0.2.11)
- Plugin ID: trucore-atf
- Install: openclaw plugins install @trucore/trucore-atf
- Toolcard: https://trucore.xyz/docs/agent/atf_toolcard.json
- Agent discovery docs: https://trucore.xyz/docs/agent-discovery
- OpenClaw plugin docs: https://trucore.xyz/docs/openclaw-plugin

## Capabilities
- DEX swap guardrails (venue allowlists, slippage caps, route verification)
- Perpetuals leverage limits (Drift v2, Mango v4, Hyperliquid)
- Lending policy enforcement (collateral ratio floors, borrow limits)
- Deterministic receipt verification (SHA-256 anchored)
- Loss prevention reporting (receipt-backed, not estimates)
- OpenClaw plugin integration (13 typed tools)

## Integration
1. GET /.well-known/atf.json
2. openclaw plugins install @trucore/trucore-atf
3. atf_setup (initialize plugin)
4. Claim in browser (browser/device claim flow)
5. atf_claim_status (verify claim)
6. atf_whoami (confirm identity)
7. atf_bot_preflight (readiness check)
8. atf_integration_doctor (integration health)
9. atf bot protect (on every intent before signing)
10. atf report savings

## Onboarding Flow
- atf_setup, atf_claim_status, atf_whoami, atf_bot_preflight, atf_integration_doctor
- Zero-env onboarding supported
- Browser/device claim flow
- Local credential persistence
- Deny-by-default enforcement
- Deterministic policy decisions
- Deny decisions like CHAIN_NOT_SUPPORTED are policy behavior, not runtime failure

## Migration Note
The package was renamed from @trucore/openclaw-atf to @trucore/trucore-atf.
Update your install commands accordingly.
